source_snapshot.criteria: No error, hang or device loss.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Describes cold AC-off but proposes `systemctl reboot` warm reset and 500 times over 12 hours.

old_problem: Cycle type and controlling bound are mutually unresolved: cold test-set/DeepSeek description conflicts with warm command, while Items require 500 and Procedure says 12 hours.
disposition_reason: ED-06 forbids warm/cold substitution, ED-14 forbids shortening or replacing formal duration, and ED-18 requires complete cycle proof. Selecting any path or priority would change core coverage and cannot be parameterized safely.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row71 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3101 and actual next row73/history3102 were read.
`systemctl reboot` cannot prove cold power loss, yet the source does not define the required power-state boundary.
500 cycles within 12 hours averages under 86.4 seconds including readiness; the source does not say whether count, duration or both govern.
No controller, retry, readiness or recovery can be finalized until both conflicts are resolved; no reboot ran.

test_case.expected_result: Cannot be finalized until the state transition and controlling bound are approved.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS from warm `systemctl reboot` labeled cold, fewer than 500 cycles, elapsed 12 hours alone or silent retries.
